module: "Prefabs" panel of the mission editor. It edits the mission.prefabs list (paths of .prefab / .prefab.json files) and the boolean prefabsRequireCollisionReload. Each row has a path field, a file picker, an existence indicator (FS:fileExists) and a "Spawn" button that instantiates the prefab in MissionGroup. The module returns a constructor: require(...)(missionEditor).
notes: Spawn: spawnPrefab(unique name, file, "0 0 0", "0 0 1 0", "1 1 1"), loadMode = 0, added to scenetree.MissionGroup then selected in the editor.
A new prefab added by "Add" is "/" until it is edited.
The delete button uses originalPrefabName in its imgui id; the self.filenames list is parallel to mission.prefabs.

C.desc: Instance of the panel. Fields: missionEditor, mission, filenames (imgui buffers), prefabsRequireCollisionReload.

setMission.desc: Sets the mission and recreates the text buffers from mission.prefabs.

draw.desc: Draws the prefabs list (deletion, path, picker, status, spawn), the "Add" button and the "Requires collision reload" checkbox.
